name: TrustLens Web Security Posture Taxonomy
description: Standardized multi-label security finding and posture categorization system for web technical security analysis.

status_definitions.PASS: The security control was verified to be correctly implemented according to baseline security standards.
status_definitions.FAIL: A verified security weakness or misconfiguration was detected that degrades technical security posture.
status_definitions.WARN: A security concern or optimization opportunity was detected, but it does not represent an unambiguous violation.
status_definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: The security control does not apply to this specific endpoint configuration (e.g., HTTP-only controls on non-HTTP services).
status_definitions.UNKNOWN: Insufficient telemetry or inconclusive response prevented authoritative determination.

CRITICAL.description: Direct, severe exposure or total breakdown of transport security (e.g. expired certificate, TLS downgrade, completely broken HTTPS). Precludes GOOD or MODERATE posture.

HIGH.description: Substantial cryptographic or authentication weakness (e.g. deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1, self-signed certificate, weak ciphers). Precludes GOOD posture.

MEDIUM.description: Absence of core foundational defense-in-depth controls (e.g. missing HSTS, missing Content-Security-Policy, cookies transmitted without Secure flag).

LOW.description: Absence of secondary hardening headers or minor misconfigurations (e.g. missing X-Content-Type-Options, missing Referrer-Policy, banner version disclosure).

INFO.description: Informational observation or optional modern defense mechanism (e.g. CAA records, Permissions-Policy, modern TLS 1.3 indicator).

GOOD.criteria: Numerical posture score >= 80, and zero findings with severity HIGH or CRITICAL.

MODERATE.criteria: Numerical posture score between 50 and 79, with no unmitigated CRITICAL findings.

POOR.criteria: Numerical posture score < 50, or presence of one or more CRITICAL security findings.

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.criteria: Domain could not be resolved or connected to, rendering technical posture indeterminable.

finding_catalog.name: Missing or Inaccessible HTTPS
finding_catalog.recommendation: Deploy a valid TLS certificate from an accredited Certificate Authority and enable HTTPS on port 443.

finding_catalog.name: Expired TLS Certificate
finding_catalog.recommendation: Renew the TLS certificate immediately using automated issuance (e.g. ACME) to prevent browser connection blocks.

finding_catalog.name: Certificate Hostname Mismatch
finding_catalog.recommendation: Reissue certificate ensuring the requested domain name is listed in the Subject Alternative Names (SAN) extension.

finding_catalog.name: Self-Signed Certificate in Production
finding_catalog.recommendation: Replace self-signed certificate with one issued by a trusted public root CA from the Mozilla CCADB store.

finding_catalog.name: Deprecated TLS Protocol Version (TLS 1.0/1.1)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1 in web server and load balancer configurations; enforce TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 minimum.

finding_catalog.name: Certificate Expiring Within 15 Days
finding_catalog.recommendation: Verify automated renewal pipeline is operational before certificate reaches expiration.

finding_catalog.name: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Configure 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload' on all HTTPS responses.

finding_catalog.name: HSTS max-age Below Recommended Threshold
finding_catalog.recommendation: Increase HSTS max-age to at least 10886400 seconds (126 days), preferably 31536000 seconds (1 year).

finding_catalog.name: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Deploy a robust Content-Security-Policy header restricting script-src, object-src, and default-src.

finding_catalog.name: Permissive Content-Security-Policy Directives
finding_catalog.recommendation: Refactor inline scripts and styles to use cryptographic nonces or hashes rather than 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval'.

finding_catalog.name: Missing Clickjacking Protection (X-Frame-Options)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Set 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN', or define 'frame-ancestors' in Content-Security-Policy.

finding_catalog.name: Missing MIME-Sniffing Protection (X-Content-Type-Options)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' header to prevent browsers from MIME-sniffing away from declared Content-Type.

finding_catalog.name: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
finding_catalog.recommendation: Deploy 'Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin' to protect sensitive URL parameters in HTTP referrers.

finding_catalog.name: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
finding_catalog.recommendation: Define 'Permissions-Policy' to restrict sensitive browser features such as camera, microphone, and geolocation.

finding_catalog.name: Missing Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy (COOP)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Deploy 'Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin' to isolate browsing contexts from cross-origin attacks.

finding_catalog.name: Missing Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy (CORP)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Deploy 'Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin' to prevent cross-origin reads of static assets.

finding_catalog.name: Missing Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy (COEP)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Deploy 'Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp' where cross-origin resource isolation is needed.

finding_catalog.name: Insecure Cookie Transmission (Missing Secure Flag)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Ensure all Set-Cookie directives include the 'Secure' attribute to prevent transmission over cleartext HTTP.

finding_catalog.name: Sensitive Cookie Accessible to Script (Missing HttpOnly)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Append 'HttpOnly' flag to authentication and session cookies to mitigate client-side script theft.

finding_catalog.name: Cookie Lacks SameSite Attribute
finding_catalog.recommendation: Set 'SameSite=Lax' or 'SameSite=Strict' on all cookies to mitigate cross-site request forgery (CSRF).

finding_catalog.name: Plain HTTP Does Not Redirect to HTTPS
finding_catalog.recommendation: Configure web server to return a 301 Permanent Redirect on port 80 to the corresponding HTTPS endpoint.

finding_catalog.name: Insecure HTTPS-to-HTTP Downgrade in Redirect Chain
finding_catalog.recommendation: Eliminate redirect hops that route through plain HTTP (port 80) from an initial HTTPS origin.

finding_catalog.name: Server Header Discloses Detailed Version
finding_catalog.recommendation: Configure ServerTokens Prod (Apache) or server_tokens off (Nginx) to minimize version disclosure.

finding_catalog.name: Framework Exposure via X-Powered-By Header
finding_catalog.recommendation: Disable the X-Powered-By header in application framework configurations (e.g., expose_php = Off).

finding_catalog.name: Missing DNS CAA Record
finding_catalog.recommendation: Publish DNS CAA resource records specifying which Certificate Authorities are authorized to issue certificates for the domain.

finding_catalog.name: DNSSEC Not Deployed
finding_catalog.recommendation: Sign the authoritative DNS zone with DNSSEC to prevent cache poisoning and DNS spoofing.

finding_catalog.name: Domain Resolution Failure (NXDOMAIN / SERVFAIL)
finding_catalog.recommendation: Check zone file delegation, nameserver availability, and registrar DNS configuration.
